name: LinkedIn: Open Post
summary: Open one LinkedIn post and return it as one rzn.item/v2.
description: Open one LinkedIn post permalink in the user's signed-in Chrome and return the post as one rzn.item/v2, keyed exactly as linkedin/posts keys it. Comments are not returned.

url.description: A LinkedIn post permalink: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity|share|ugcPost:<id>/ (the item url linkedin/posts returns) or /posts/<slug>-activity-<id>-…

help.summary: Open one LinkedIn post and return it as one rzn.item/v2.
returns: rzn.item/v2: key linkedin:post:<id> (the id of the post's own urn:li:activity|share|ugcPost link; the activity id where the page shows one), kind post, url /feed/update/urn:li:<type>:<id>/, author (name, id = profile or company slug, url), published_at (RFC 3339, from the id's time bits), published_in LinkedIn, marker text:<hash of the text>, counts reactions/comments/reposts; one post block (the whole text) plus a quoted block when the post quotes another. truncated is set when the text stayed collapsed; such an item is not indexed. The key is the URL's id.
notes: Read-only. Never likes, comments, reposts, or connects.
Makes no request of its own: it opens the post's page, clicks '… more' as a person would, and reads what LinkedIn rendered.

steps.name: Open the collapsed text and map the post
